question: What was the total gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) collection recorded in May 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1.94 lakh crore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Gross **GST collections** in **May 2026** rose by **3.2%** to exceed **₹1.94 lakh crore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **₹1.94 lakh crore**: This was the total **gross GST collection** reported for the month of **May 2026**, driven by improved supplies and imports.
 
• **₹1.88 lakh crore**: This represents the **gross GST collection** recorded in the same month of the previous year (**May 2025**).
 
• **₹1.67 lakh crore**: This was the **net GST revenue** in May 2026 after adjusting for **refunds**, showing a **3.3%** growth.
 
• **₹2.43 lakh crore**: This figure refers to the **all-time high** GST mop-up recorded in **April 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Breakdown of May 2026 collections: **CGST** stood at **₹37,397 crore**, **SGST** at **₹45,143 crore**, and **IGST** at **₹51,990 crore** from domestic transactions.
 
• **IGST from imports** rose by **19.1%** to reach **₹59,654 crore**, indicating an expansion in industrial capacity.
 
• **GST refunds** during this period grew by **2.6%** to **₹27,281 crore**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The **taxable supplies of goods** grew significantly by **26.9%**, reflecting strong **domestic demand**.
 
• The **services sector** saw a growth of **22.2%** in taxable supplies, demonstrating **structural resilience** in domestic consumption.
